name: breachledger
description: BreachBook (breachbook.org) — a structured public record of disclosed U.S. data breaches, with a remediation engine and litigation tracking. Every published fact traces to a citable government or court source. The package/infrastructure name remains 'breachledger' from the original build.

scripts.db:seed: node packages/schema/seed/load.js --out .wrangler/tmp-seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute breachledger --local --file .wrangler/tmp-seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: node packages/schema/seed/load.js --out .wrangler/tmp-seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute breachledger --remote --file .wrangler/tmp-seed.sql
scripts.db:verify: wrangler d1 execute breachledger --local --command "SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data_classes) AS data_classes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM state_rights) AS state_rights, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM remediation_modules) AS remediation_modules, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM breaches) AS breaches, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sources) AS sources, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM litigation) AS litigation"
scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.deploy: npm test && npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name breachledger --branch "${PAGES_BRANCH:-main}" --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name breachledger --branch preview --commit-dirty=true
scripts.test: node --test packages/severity/score.test.js packages/ingest/entity-resolve.test.js packages/ingest/csv.test.js packages/ingest/slug.test.js packages/ingest/dedupe.test.js packages/ingest/validate.test.js packages/ingest/d1-writer.test.js packages/ingest/fetch-util.test.js packages/ingest/manifest.test.js packages/ingest/run-staging.test.js packages/ingest/sql-injection.test.js packages/ingest/sources/hhs-jsf.test.js packages/ingest/sources/hhs-tabview.test.js packages/ingest/sources/hhs-ocr.test.js packages/ingest/sources/hhs-part2.test.js packages/ingest/sources/hhs-ocr-fetch.test.js packages/schema/sql.test.js packages/schema/seed/load.test.js site/build-guard.test.js site/theme-contrast.test.js site/templates/markdown.test.js site/templates/breach-detail.test.js site/templates/structured-data.test.js site/templates/breach-table.test.js site/templates/state-rights.test.js site/templates/remediation.test.js workers/routing.test.js site/templates/year-archive.test.js site/templates/sector-hub.test.js site/templates/home.test.js site/templates/severity.test.js scripts/refresh-receipt.test.js
